project_type: Full-stack social media platform (Next.js frontend + Express backend + PostgreSQL)
build_system: npm workspaces with separate frontend (Next.js) and backend (Express) packages inside /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/
test_framework: Jest for backend, Jest + React Testing Library for frontend
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend && npm run build && cd /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend && npm run build
test_command: cd /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend && npm test && cd /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend && npm test
verification_instructions: 1. Run backend build and tests. 2. Run frontend build and tests. 3. Docker compose up to verify full stack integration.
setup_instructions: All built inside /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/ folder. Backend at craq/backend, frontend at craq/frontend. PostgreSQL and Redis via Docker Compose.
environment_constraints: Node.js 22 available, Docker available, full network access for npm installs. No pre-installed PostgreSQL or Redis on host - use Docker containers.
contribution_requirements: Greenfield project - no existing contribution guidelines. Build everything from scratch.
key_patterns: Backend: Express + TypeScript with controllers/services/routes pattern. Frontend: Next.js App Router with server components. Auth: JWT + Google OAuth. AI: Multi-provider gateway with OpenAI-compatible API.
directory_structure: craq/ - root of the platform. craq/backend/ - Express API server. craq/frontend/ - Next.js app. craq/docker-compose.yml - PostgreSQL, Redis, Meilisearch orchestration.
